remarks:
WOW! This gem is tucked away on a dead end and has all the perks of being near the events throughout the Village of Williamsville without the additional village taxes! Located between Main St and Wehrle Dr, this property is close to the airport, thruway access ramps, parks, shopping, restaurants and so much more.

This versatile home boasts over 3000 sq ft, 5 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. While technically a double, this property can easily be used as a single family home. The lower consists of the main unit that has 2 bedrooms, a full bathroom, living room, formal dining room and a wet bar. There is a separate entrance from the back deck into the laundry room hallway. There is an additional bedroom, full bathroom, living room (4th bedroom) with a small kitchenette that is was being used for Air BNB. While this area is separated by a lockable door, it is part of the lower residence and could make a great in-law unit. The upper unit has an open concept with a living, dining and kitchen area. There us also a spacious bedroom and full bathroom.

There is tons of storage space in the full dry basement as well as in the 4+ car heated garage.

Entertain to your hearts delight with the massive driveway for guest parking, a wet bar, a large deck with an above ground pool and a spacious yard! 

Don't wait to check out this amazing property!
